decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate is a flagship built on the firm's long agricultural crate and injection-moulding expertise, so it can interpret harvest-season results and keep refining the design in-house, even though the website shows no evidence for 2020 to 2021.

Foldable large containers are a core competence for automotive and industrial customers, where the firm's deep related knowledge lets it absorb customer feedback and keep improving the multi-model line.
Stackable crates sit at the centre of the firm's knowledge base and serve its food and retail customers, so they are easy to adapt and there is little reason to withdraw them.
The medium-duty rackable pallet extends established pallet engineering, which makes its market results easy to read and fits pooling and industrial demand.

The pallet with load retainers is a niche variant that could be folded into the broader pallet range, but the firm can still assimilate and adjust it cheaply through its own engineering, so keeping it is justified for now.
